name: Old Leicester Road

layers.essential_history: [[c:Old Leicester Road leads west out of Wansford. Its name remembers the old route from here towards Leicester and the Midlands.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Wansford sat where roads to the north and to the Midlands met the river crossing, which is why it had so many inns.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A carter on the Leicester road says the London coach came in late last night, and its guard was in a hurry to unload. (Long walk only.)]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Head east, about 160 metres as the crow flies, to the Old North Road. Turn north-east along the Old North Road. Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
